title: JANUS Linear A source-agnostic lossless transcription substrate
purpose: Turn JANUS Linear A from a collection of source-specific parsers into a lossless, provenance-carrying transcription substrate that can ingest mwenge, SigLA, CTLA, TMT, RILA-S1 or future sources without forcing one source's tokenization, numeric grammar, word boundaries, uncertainty notation or editorial decisions onto another source.

typed_numeric_baseline.relationship: Provides a proven mwenge-specific generic numeric-literal repair. It is not automatically imposed on alternate editorial sources; every new adapter must declare its own source-native numeric grammar.

architectural_principles: RAW_FIRST_LOSSLESS: source-native literal text, IDs and ordering are immutable evidence and must survive every derived normalization.
PROVENANCE_ATOMIC: every document, segment, token, reading and bridge edge can carry exact source/file/page/locator provenance.
TYPE_BEFORE_SEMANTICS: punctuation, numeric, damage, uncertainty, separator and editorial markers are typed before lexical hashing/scoring.
APPROX_IS_NOT_EXACT: approximate or uncertain numeric structure may be recognized without receiving a false exact magnitude.
SOURCE_WORD_IS_NOT_UNIVERSAL_WORD: source-native grouping may be represented, but JANUS must not silently promote it to a cross-source linguistic word boundary.
DISAGREEMENT_IS_DATA: conflicting readings, token counts, boundaries, sign IDs or layout are retained as explicit disagreements rather than coerced away.
LAYOUT_IS_FIRST_CLASS: side, surface, zone, line, row, column, reading direction and spatial boxes are representable independently of token text.
ALTERNATIVES_ARE_BRANCHES: alternate readings and uncertain sign identifications are explicit competing branches with provenance, not flattened strings.
BRIDGES_ARE_TYPED_EDGES: document/sign/group/token correspondences carry relation type, confidence/evidence class and collision state.
FAIL_CLOSED: absent required provenance, malformed ordinals, ambiguous identity or unsupported normalization blocks promotion rather than triggering fallback guessing.

document.rule: Unknown values remain null/absent; they are never inferred from a bridged source without an explicit provenance edge.

tokens.identity: token_id unique within document and stable inside one frozen source ingest
tokens.semantic_candidate_rule: Only token types explicitly admitted by a downstream frozen scientific ontology may enter lexical/sign candidate identity. Numeric, punctuation, damage, gap, illegible, editorial and MASK types are non-semantic by default.

rules: numerator and denominator are integers encoded as decimal strings
canonical_fraction must be reduced and preserve sign in numerator
bounded_interval may be present only if the source explicitly supplies bounds

numeric.source_specific_grammar_rule: An adapter may reuse v0.6.2 grammar only if its source contract explicitly freezes that choice. New editorial sources must not inherit mwenge numeric conventions by convenience.

readings_and_uncertainty.certainty_rule: Numeric certainty scores are optional metadata and never replace categorical/source-native uncertainty notation.

alternatives.rule: No alternative is silently promoted to primary solely because another source agrees with it.

groups.purpose: Represent source-native grouping without asserting universal linguistic wordhood.
rules: member order is explicit and source-native unless derived=true
SOURCE_WORD is evidence about the source interface/editorial segmentation, not independent linguistic validation

relations.rule: Cross-source edges never mutate the source-native nodes they connect.

disagreements.promotion_rule: Resolving a technical bridge does not erase the original disagreement record.

normalization_layers.description: Source-native tokens receive non-semantic structural types without changing raw literals.
Optional source-specific canonical IDs/numeric exact fractions under a frozen adapter contract.
Cross-source identity/compatibility/conflict edges are added; source nodes remain immutable.
A frozen experiment projects only explicitly eligible fields/tokens from L3. No scientific experiment consumes untyped raw strings directly.

hashing_and_identity.document_IR_hash: SHA-256 over canonical JSON serialization with sorted object keys and compact separators, excluding only the ir_sha256 field itself.
hashing_and_identity.token_identity: Source-local token_id is not a universal sign identity. Universalization requires a typed bridge edge.
hashing_and_identity.scientific_candidate_hash: Must include ontology/version namespace and may consume only fields allowed by the frozen scientific view.

validator_fail_closed_rules: duplicate token_id, group_id, segment_id, relation_id, disagreement_id or provenance ref ID
exact numeric token missing valid reduced rational representation
approximate/uncertain numeric token carrying non-null exact_value
SOURCE_WORD or derived group missing provenance/derivation identity
scientific view attempting to admit non-semantic token types without an explicit frozen ontology exception

compatibility_targets.mwenge: Adapter may map existing v0.6.2 typed output into IR while preserving original row/line/word indices and raw token text.
compatibility_targets.SigLA: Adapter may map document-view/seq-pattern/word-N structures into source-native groups and token relations without promoting SOURCE_WORD to universal wordhood.
compatibility_targets.CTLA_TMT_RILA: Adapters remain source-specific and cannot be implemented until exact source bytes/pages and notation conventions are frozen under R3B-0.

R3B_integration.R3B_1: Overlap freeze selects documents before transcription-level comparison and requires each source side to serialize into this IR.
R3B_integration.R3B_2: Source-specific adapter validation proves lossless/typed ingest independently of cross-source scientific outcomes.
R3B_integration.R3B_3: Disagreement-preserving identity bridge aligns source-native IR nodes.
R3B_integration.R3B_4: Only then may a locked external/cross-editorial replication experiment consume an L4 scientific view.
